_comment: Capture scenarios. One entry = one page to open.
Every GraphQL response the page makes is saved, without exception, so the
fixtures describe X's behaviour rather than a guess about what QuaX needs.
The description is copied into every fixture the link produces, under the
"scenario" key, so a test can say why the fixture exists.
A profile URL triggers UserByScreenName AND the profile timeline at once,
and the script scrolls, so later pages come for free.
"unstable": true marks a page whose content changes between captures
(someone else's timeline, a search, the home timeline): tests may only check its shape.
